description: Show several visual directions side by side so the user can choose, for requests like 'give me 10 blend ideas for my campaign' or 'show me some visual directions'. A direction can be one style or a blend: when asked for several, make about half single styles and half blends, so the user sees each style on its own as well as mixed. Pick the pairs first (search_styles, find_styles_by_attributes), then send them all in one call. Returns one comparable card per blend: what each style brings and its weight, three small examples on every card (Website, Social media, Out in the world), Omoro reference images, palette, fonts, a one-line feel, defining traits and card colours taken from the blend itself. To restyle an existing brand, pass brand with its exact colours: every card then keeps those colours and the styles change its fonts, layout and texture, with the brand today shown first as card 00. Present them as a visual shortlist, not text, and use blend_styles only for the ones the user picks.

applications.description: Up to three uses to show as small examples on every card, such as 'Instagram post' or 'Pricing page'. Defaults to Website, Social media and Out in the world.

brand.description: An existing brand to restyle. Its colours stay fixed on every idea; the styles change its type, layout and texture. Use the user's real brand facts only.

current_fonts.description: The brand's fonts today, display first.

headline.description: A real line from the brand to set on every card.

keep.description: Anything else that must not change, such as the logo.

brief.description: The project or campaign these ideas are for.

options.description: Two to twelve directions. Each is one style, or a blend of two or three style slugs with the lead first. Make about half single styles and half blends.

explanation.description: Two or three plain sentences on what this direction is and why it suits the brief. Built from the styles if omitted.

feel.description: One short line on how it feels for this brief.

mix.description: Percentage led by the second style.

title.description: A name for the idea, up to four words.

name: present_blend_options
